title: Four changes to avenCEO become intents
quote: Good: take all four changes to avenCEO.
means: The four changes aip-6fb1's reflection proposed each become an intent, measured before they are kept: a check is a script a machine runs (aip-f663), events stamped by a machine (aip-6219), a kind on every finding (aip-55e6), and one spec round while you are reachable (aip-c455).

reflection.checked: every decision before d-f7b3 that held
